title: Cool Creature ABC
hook: Behavior helps body temperature track the environment.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: soft 3D cold-blooded-creature storybook, natural greens browns and water blues, friendly educational presentation

creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written thermal behavior; no universal basking claim
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: temperature cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe sun/shade gesture

creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a kalimba pattern-pluck plus soft bell glint after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Cold-Blooded Creatures into an ectothermy song: reptiles and amphibians rely strongly on external heat sources and behavioral thermoregulation, but their blood is not simply 'cold'.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child follows sun, shade, burrow and water as temperature choices; color/pattern is secondary.
